correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the posterior variance and global argument in RESULT.md lines 47–102. The Dirichlet inverse of −d²/dt² applied to 2t−1 gives g=t(1−t)(2t−1)/6 and Var(J)=1/180. Cubic averaging yields the stated cross covariance, and direct averaging of min(s,t)−st gives a+h/3−c²=c(1−c)−h/6 for a=c−h/2. The noisy variance is positive even at the boundary since its minimum without noise is h(4−3h)/12. With z=c(1−c), every interior derivative sign is the sign of the stated quadratic N, and N(1/4)<0. If S>0 strict concavity and endpoint signs give a unique simple crossing; if S≤0 then h≥h₀ and N'(L_h)<0, so N is strictly negative beyond L_h even at equality. The reflected centers exhaust the optimizers; the midpoint has zero reduction. The interior log derivative is strictly increasing in eta and has negative z derivative at its simple maximizing root, establishing inward motion. Implicit differentiation at threshold gives N_eta(L_h)=8(1−h)(1−2h) and dz/dc=1−h, reproducing the positive onset coefficient. Uniform convergence of eta times the objective to its numerator gives the constrained large-noise limit with maximizer z=(2+h²)/12 when h<1/2. Independent bisection of the log derivative on [7/64,1/4] for h=1/4, eta=1/5 gave c=0.196817468335539 and a relative variance-reduction gain of 27.6931016062%. Inspected verify.py, VERIFICATION.md and the printed verification output without running the supplied script.

evidence: The closest sources supply the posterior-risk framework or exact optimizers in materially different design families. claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: A h=0 point limit does not decide contact for any positive footprint. An exact optimum for each separately weighted target likewise gives no theorem for the signed contrast; its covariance is squared only after taking the difference. The exact classification is not a mechanically covered specialization of those results.

value.rationale: A fixed nonzero footprint is a motivated measurement constraint. The optimization gives a complete boundary-versus-interior design rule across all widths and noise levels, including exact onset and a limiting location, rather than just a numerical improvement at one setting. The two optimizers and their degeneracies are fully resolved for the scalar design, without making a multi-sensor or arbitrary-prior claim.
